$comment: What every setting in this section does, its type and allowed values; defaults are in config.json beside this file. See scripts/pipeline/lib/settings.mjs.

architectureReview.timeoutSec.does: The normal time the architecture reviewer may take.

architectureReview.conventions.does: Documents the reviewer checks the change against.

architectureReview.policy.enabled.does: Runs the architecture policy step before the reviewer.

architectureReview.policy.agent.does: The policy engine's script, relative to the factory install.

architectureReview.policy.dir.does: The folder of the repository's architecture rules.

architectureReview.policy.command.does: The command that runs a policy review (`{agent}` is the engine's script).

architectureReview.policy.lessonsCommand.does: The command that reads the policy's lessons (`{agent}` is the engine's script).

architectureReview.policy.categories.does: The policy's finding categories mapped to the review's.

architectureReview.policy.maxLessons.does: The most policy lessons handed to the reviewer.

architectureReview.policy.requester.does: The agent the policy review is requested for.

architectureReview.policy.semantic.does: Whether pending semantic rules go to the reviewer (`auto`) or are left out (`off`).

architectureReview.policy.timeoutSec.does: How long the policy engine's command may take.

architectureReview.maxCouncilRounds.does: How many rounds the architecture review council gets before the stage escalates to a person (any council size).

architectureReview.councilPassScore.does: The score every blocking member of the architecture review council must give, with no blocking finding standing, for it to pass (any council size).

architectureReview.councilMembers.does: How many members sit on the architecture review council (`null`: `council.members`).

architectureReview.orchestrator.model.does: The `models.pool` entry the architecture review orchestrator runs on (`null`: `orchestrator.model`).

architectureReview.orchestrator.effort.does: The architecture review orchestrator's reasoning effort (`null`: `orchestrator.effort`, else its entry's).

architectureReview.councilIntercom.does: The architecture review council's own discussion settings, over `council.intercom` (a council of one holds no discussion).
